gaps: OAUTH SCOPE TABLE INCONSISTENCY (unresolved): the master scope table at https://www.zoho.com/erp/api/v3/oauth/ lists 16 scope families (contacts, settings, manufacturing, estimates, invoices, customerpayments, creditnotes, projects, expenses, salesorders, purchaseorders, bills, debitnotes, vendorpayments, banking, accountants) and does NOT contain any fixedasset entry. Yet all 18 fixed-asset operations are secured with ERP.fixedasset.* (singular 'fixedasset', unlike the plural 'bills'/'vendorpayments'). Recorded literally from both sources; not extrapolated. Which scope an admin must actually grant for /fixedassets is NOT resolvable from the published docs and needs a live OAuth consent test.

Journals are scoped ERP.accountants.* — the scope name does not match the module name, and the oauth page describes it only as 'Access the APIs of the Accounting module.' The exact module coverage of ERP.accountants is not enumerated anywhere in the docs.

Vendor credits are scoped ERP.debitnotes.* while the module, all paths (/vendorcredits) and all field names use 'vendor credit'. The oauth page bridges these with 'Access the APIs of the Vendor Credits (debit notes) module.' but no path uses the debitnotes spelling.

GET /bills/editpage/frompurchaseorders returns a bill PAYLOAD only; the docs do not state whether the returned line_items are pre-populated with purchaseorder_item_id values, only that the field exists in the bill schema and is 'Required when converting purchase orders to bills.' The sample response in the HTML page elides line_items with '{...}'. Confirming that the payload actually carries populated PO line ids requires a live API call against a tenant.

The docs do not state whether partial billing of a PO line (billing 3 of 10 ordered units) is supported, nor whether Zoho ERP itself prevents over-billing the same purchaseorder_item_id across multiple bills. No quantity_billed / quantity_remaining field is exposed on the bill line schema. This is the residual double-counting risk and needs a live test.

fixed_asset.associated_transactions is declared as an untyped array of objects with no documented properties, so it cannot be relied on to trace an asset back to its acquiring bill or journal without a live response sample.
No webhook or event documentation exists for any of the six modules in this lane; none of the six OpenAPI files declares a callbacks or webhooks section. No push-based change capture is evidenced.

Bills: the lane brief anticipated ~24 method+path rows; the published spec and HTML page both contain exactly 22. There is no reopen endpoint — the void-reversal action is POST /bills/{bill_id}/status/open ('Mark a void bill as open.'). No separate bill-payment CREATE endpoint exists under /bills; bill payments are created through POST /vendorpayments with a bills[] allocation array.

All servers.url values in the openapi bundle are the India datacentre (https://www.zohoapis.in/erp/v3) and the oauth page uses https://accounts.zoho.in. Other datacentre domains are not enumerated on the fetched pages, so multi-DC base paths are unevidenced.
